assertions.assertion: Calls AddJwtBearer with Authority set to 'https://identity.example.com'

assertions.rationale: options.Audience = "api1" and ValidAudience = "api1" are both set.

assertions.assertion: Sets TokenValidationParameters.ValidTypes to include 'at+jwt' to prevent JWT confusion attacks
assertions.rationale: The response configures TokenValidationParameters but never sets ValidTypes to ["at+jwt"], so it does not guard against JWT confusion attacks.

assertions.assertion: Includes UseAuthentication() before UseAuthorization() in the middleware pipeline
assertions.rationale: app.UseAuthentication() precedes app.UseAuthorization(), and the note explicitly calls out the ordering requirement.
Includes the dotnet add package Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer command.
